cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our invisible dinner guest is here. Introduce Mum while I finish the gravy, love.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't see where to look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stand beside the guest. Look towards me when you introduce her.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair, this is Mum. She needs your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch Mum another chair. Introduce her to our guest, love.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leads hospitality and A3 offers orientation; A5 takes extra-chair work to keep B introducing the invisible guest.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 orientation difficulty causes A3 standing cue; B4 seat concern causes A5 chair solution, but B address to chair has no previous chair location cue.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs to know where to look and B4 wants Mum seated.

heightening.evidence: A5 practical seating solution keeps the guest included without an explanatory moral.

specificity.evidence: A1 invisibility is explicit; A3 should identify the guest chair so B4 addressing it follows the actual cue rather than imagined positioning.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 can add the chair reference without burdening the concise A5.
